title: Shell Task
description: A supervised shell task started by shell_exec. Planned contract for keryx-background-task-execution (v1.1.0).

taskId.description: Session-scoped identifier; the task-<n>-<pid> shape generalizes the existing job-<n>-<pid>.

pid.description: Direct child PID; also the process-group id (detached spawn).

status.description: D-14: completed = exit 0, failed = non-zero exit, killed = a kill was requested (see killReason). No 'unknown': tasks are not persisted.

phase.description: D-12: foreground until the yield elapses (or background immediately with background:true). Only background tasks count toward the concurrency cap.

killReason.description: Present only when status is killed (D-14).

output.description: Bounded retained output: a 2 MiB ring, shrunk to a 4 000-byte tail once the completion is delivered (D-18).

idleTimeoutMs.description: Effective idle timeout. A per-call value is clamped to [1000, 1800000]; 0 only via operator env KERYX_SHELL_IDLE_MS=0 (D-13).

observed.description: The main session has seen this task's terminal status (tool result or delivered notification). Drives exactly-once delivery (N5, D-10, D-16).
